Thanks Marissa — happy to host. Quick note from experience: when we send provisional invites some corporate systems rewrite the organizer headers and cause the RSVP/ICS to be treated as an import, which prevents reminders and RSVP from surfacing for contractors. To avoid that, I recommend we:  

- Send the provisional Zoom meeting as a standalone calendar event (ICS attached) with the Redwood organizer in the body but also include "AlphaHealth confirmed host" in the event title so their calendar doesn't auto-strip.
- For contractors on the waitlist, include a short paragraph in the event body with the exact steps to join as guest; AlphaHealth IT can paste that into their internal allowlist if needed.

I'll create the provisional Zoom now and attach the .ics here — Marissa, feel free to edit the event title after I create it.
